name: cities.json 1.1.61 (GeoNames-derived)
note: GeoNames is the authority and is itself CC BY 4.0, but its dumps are regenerated
daily at unversioned URLs, so an integrity hash pinned against one would fail every
morning and teach everyone to ignore it. This package is a versioned, immutable npm
release of the same gazetteer, with no dependencies -- the mime-db trade again: one
intermediary, in exchange for a supply chain that can actually be verified.
CC BY 4.0 requires attribution, not share-alike, so it composes with Apache-2.0.
GeoNames must be credited wherever the corpus is; docs/corpus-strategy.md carries it.
Chosen over `all-the-cities`, which ships the same data as protobuf and needs a
decoder dependency -- the toolchain has none and should keep it that way.
